Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And God said to Moses: 'Now you shall see what I shall do to Pharaoh — for by a mighty hand he shall release them, and by a mighty hand he shall drive them out of his land.'
translations.2: Then God spoke to Moses, and said to him: 'I am God,
translations.3: who appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as the All-Sufficient One; but My name — God alone — I did not make known to them.
translations.4: And also I confirmed My covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan — the land of their sojourning, which they sojourned in.
translations.5: And also I have heard the groaning of the sons of Israel, from what the Egyptians press them into as service; and I have remembered My covenant.
translations.6: Therefore say to the sons of Israel: I am God — I have sworn to bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and to deliver you from their service, and to redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.
translations.7: And I shall take you to Me as a nation, and I shall be to you the God; and you shall know that I am God your Lord, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
translations.8: And I shall bring you into the land which I swore by My word to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; and I shall give it to you as a possession — I am God, I shall fulfil this.'
translations.9: And Moses spoke thus to the sons of Israel; but they did not accept from him, because of the anguish of their souls and their hard service.
translations.10: Then God spoke to Moses directly.
translations.11: 'Go in, speak to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, that he release the sons of Israel from his land.'
translations.12: He said: 'O my Lord, behold — the sons of Israel did not accept from me; so how shall Pharaoh accept from me, when I am thick of speech?'
translations.13: And God spoke to Moses and Aaron, and charged the two of them concerning the sons of Israel and concerning Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
translations.14: These are the heads of their fathers' houses. The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi — these are the clans of Reuben.
translations.15: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and Jachin and Zohar, and Shaul the son of the Canaanite woman — these are the clans of Simeon.
translations.16: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were a hundred and thirty-seven years.
translations.17: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their clans.
translations.18: And the sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar, and Hebron and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were a hundred and thirty-three years.
translations.19: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites according to their generations.
translations.20: And Amram married Jochebed his aunt, before she became forbidden to him; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. And the years of his life were a hundred and thirty-seven years.
translations.21: And the sons of Izhar: Korah and Nepheg and Zichri.
translations.22: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael and Elzaphan and Sithri.
translations.23: And Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
translations.24: And the sons of Korah: Assir and Elkanah and Abiasaph — these are the clans of Korah.
translations.25: And Eleazar son of Aaron married a woman from the daughters of Putiel; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their clans.
translations.26: They are Aaron and Moses — those to whom God said: 'Bring out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their hosts.'
translations.27: They are the ones who addressed Pharaoh, king of Egypt, that he bring out the sons of Israel from Egypt — they are Moses and Aaron.
translations.28: And it was on the day that God spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
translations.29: God said to Moses: 'I am God — speak to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, all that I command you.'
translations.30: And he said before Him: 'Behold, I am thick of speech — so how shall Pharaoh heed me?'
